description: Object-oriented programming groups data and useful actions together. We will build tiny JavaScript objects for a library and see how classes help us make more than one object. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain constructors set a starting state
learningObjectives: Practise inheritance adds to a class
Practise polymorphism uses one common action

seo.title: OOP Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Object-Oriented Programming with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
